title: Health Connect integration (steps, weight, workouts) — NOT Google Fit
goal: Google Fit APIs are only supported until end of 2026; build on Health Connect from day one
steps: Add health_connect_flutter (or current maintained plugin) via pubspec
Request READ/WRITE for Steps, Weight, ExerciseSession with rationale strings in Arabic
Steps hero card reads from Health Connect when permission granted; falls back to device pedometer otherwise
Weight logs write back to Health Connect
Handle permission-denied state gracefully with copy: 'من غير الإذن هنستخدم عداد الموبايل بس'
acceptance: No Google Fit dependency anywhere in the codebase
Steps sync works on a Health Connect-enabled device
